A.label: Assists
A.description: Final passes directly leading to goals.

xA.label: Expected assists
xA.description: Estimated likelihood that a pass becomes an assist.

POSS%.label: Possession
POSS%.description: Share of possession, expressed as a percentage.

FK.label: Free-kick goals
FK.description: Goals scored directly from free kicks.

TCH-BOX.label: Touches in opponent box
TCH-BOX.description: Touches inside the opposition penalty area.

PASS/M.label: Accurate passes per match
PASS/M.description: Accurate passes divided by matches played.

PASS%.label: Pass accuracy
PASS%.description: Accurate passes as a percentage of pass attempts.

PASS-ATT.label: Pass attempts
PASS-ATT.description: Total attempted passes, including incomplete passes.

BCC.label: Big chances created
BCC.description: Passes creating chances classified as big chances by the provider.

PASS-KEY.label: Key passes
PASS-KEY.description: Final passes before shots that do not result in goals.

PASS-LNG.label: Long passes
PASS-LNG.description: Passes longer than 35 yards. This count alone does not establish completion.

PASS-F3RD.label: Passes in attacking third
PASS-F3RD.description: Passes made in the attacking third; not necessarily entries into that area.

THRU-BALL.label: Through balls
THRU-BALL.description: Successful passes splitting the defensive line for a teammate.

TKL-LM.label: Last-man tackles
TKL-LM.description: Tackles by the last defender to prevent an opponent breaking through.

SH-BLK.label: Shots blocked
SH-BLK.description: Provider blocked-shot count. Its attacking or defensive direction remains unconfirmed.

CLR.label: Clearances
CLR.description: Actions clearing the ball from danger.

ERR-SH.label: Errors leading to shots
ERR-SH.description: Errors directly leading to opposition shots.

ERR-G.label: Errors leading to goals
ERR-G.description: Errors directly leading to opposition goals.

PKC.label: Penalties conceded
PKC.description: Penalties awarded to opponents. This is not the number of goals conceded.

OG.label: Own goals
OG.description: Goals scored into the club’s own net.

SV-PK.label: Penalties saved
SV-PK.description: Penalty kicks saved by the goalkeeper.

CNR-W.label: Corners won
CNR-W.description: Corner kicks won by the club.

POSS-L.label: Possessions lost
POSS-L.description: Recorded losses of possession, including unsuccessful passes and other turnovers.
